name: Radix Industries (India) Limited
about: Radix Industries (India) Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of human hair products in India. It provides wefts, ponytail, hand weft, frontals, closures, piece clipset, fishnet, and volumizer. The company also exports its products. Radix Industries (India) Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Tanuku, India.
